SELECT d.id, d.user_id AS userId, u.real_name AS realName, u.avatar, u.phone, d.department_id AS departmentId, dept.name AS departmentName, d.title, d.specialty, d.experience, d.hospital, d.consultation_fee AS consultationFee, d.rating, d.consultation_count AS consultationCount, d.introduction FROM doctor d INNER JOIN user u ON d.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 LEFT JOIN department dept ON d.department_id = dept.id AND dept.deleted = 0 WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1
AND d.department_id = #{deptId}
AND ( u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.specialty LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.hospital LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY d.rating DESC, d.consultation_count DESC

SELECT d.id, d.user_id AS userId, u.real_name AS realName, u.avatar, u.phone, d.department_id AS departmentId, dept.name AS departmentName, d.title, d.specialty, d.experience, d.education, d.hospital, d.introduction, d.consultation_fee AS consultationFee, d.rating, d.consultation_count AS consultationCount FROM doctor d INNER JOIN user u ON d.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 LEFT JOIN department dept ON d.department_id = dept.id AND dept.deleted = 0 WHERE d.id = #{doctorId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1

SELECT d.id, d.user_id AS userId, u.real_name AS realName, u.phone, u.avatar, d.department_id AS departmentId, dept.name AS departmentName, d.title, d.specialty, d.experience, d.education, d.hospital, d.introduction, d.consultation_fee AS consultationFee, d.status, CASE d.status WHEN 0 THEN '待审核' WHEN 1 THEN '正常' WHEN 2 THEN '禁用' WHEN 3 THEN '已拒绝' ELSE '未知' END AS statusName, d.create_time AS createTime FROM doctor d INNER JOIN user u ON d.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN department dept ON d.department_id = dept.id AND dept.deleted = 0 WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 0 ORDER BY d.create_time ASC
